name: PagerDuty
description: Monitor PagerDuty incident response configuration including services, escalation policies, and on-call schedules for compliance evidence

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to PagerDuty as an Admin or Account Owner.
2. In the web app, navigate to Integrations > Developer Tools > API Access Keys.
3. Click 'Create New API Key'.
4. Enter a Description (e.g. 'Comp AI'), check 'Read-only API Key', then click 'Create Key'.
5. Copy the API key (shown only once) and paste it below.

credentialFields.label: API Key
credentialFields.helpText: Found in PagerDuty > Integrations > Developer Tools > API Access Keys. Create a General Access REST API Key with 'Read-only API Key' checked.
